blocks.text: Plan the war table in the centre area.

blocks.html: Begin interrogating Legio Septimus. The player has the option to kill him outright by repeated torture which will end this section quickly, or to make his willpower low and restore his sanity high, so he answers your questions truthfully which unlocks a shortcut in the battering ram battle later.

substeps.html: To kill him outright, select Threaten him, then 'remove' crystals until Legio dies.

options.text: What is the order up to?

substeps.html: To fully interrogate him instead, threaten him until it is no longer effective. Then use Zanik's Good Cop option and Xenia's Bad Cop option until his sanity is about 50%. Then use Charm to lower his willpower to about 50% as well. Finally raise his sanity back up to about 80% using Zanik's Bad Cop option and Xenia's Good Cop Option. Ask the questions, and his answers should be sane and cooperative. Once answered, choose whether to kill or release him (choice currently has no effect on future events)

blocks.text: Battering ram

blocks.html: If you fail at any point, just go back in and click on the War Table.
Click the war table and select any two companions.
blocks.text: Click the war table and select any two companions.

blocks.html: Collect 25 wood and 25 metal. You can put both companions on the same material; by the time you complete the other, they will be finished.
blocks.text: Collect 25 wood and 25 metal. You can put both companions on the same material; by the time you complete the other, they will be finished.

blocks.html: Build the battering ram to the north (takes a few minutes while dialogue plays).

blocks.html: Slowly walk the battering ram across the bridge and through the doors.
blocks.text: Slowly walk the battering ram across the bridge and through the doors.

blocks.html: It is recommended to use an Aggression potion for this next part, to keep the focus of the enemies on you rather than the battering ram.
Suggestion 1: Put Zanik north-west by battering ram, Death north-east and the remaining four block off the start of the bridge while fighting.
blocks.text: Suggestion 1: Put Zanik north-west by battering ram, Death north-east and the remaining four block off the start of the bridge while fighting.

blocks.html: Suggestion 2: Place your companions three on each side of the ram, and stand on the bridge's edge blocking off all the monsters while using an aggression potion which requires level 82 Herblore. Fight or withstand the attacks until the ram is done.

blocks.html: Choose to either head north and assault the fortress head-on, or if you unlocked the information in the earlier interrogation, detour through the east door and enter the secret passage in the north wall of the cave, which will bypass the second half of the assault.

blocks.text: First combat phase

blocks.html: Dwindle away Nomad's health, and move away from the centre of the bridge to avoid Gielinor's hand. Also move away from shadows that appear on the ground to avoid rapid powerful magic attacks. Use Surge if you can.
blocks.text: Dwindle away Nomad's health, and move away from the centre of the bridge to avoid Gielinor's hand. Also move away from shadows that appear on the ground to avoid rapid powerful magic attacks. Use Surge if you can.
Xenia

blocks.html: Stand in the middle of each of the three sections in the area and constantly use the 3 abilities made available. Move to the next one when one side is finished.
blocks.text: Stand in the middle of each of the three sections in the area and constantly use the 3 abilities made available. Move to the next one when one side is finished.

substeps.html: Use Fire Blast when Rorarii are present.
substeps.text: Use Fire Blast when Rorarii are present.

substeps.html: Use Shield Dome when Gladii are present.
substeps.text: Use Shield Dome when Gladii are present.

substeps.html: Use Shadow Stalk when Scutarii are present.
substeps.text: Use Shadow Stalk when Scutarii are present.

substeps.text: Every time you attack a Capsarii, it will heal Xenia for a small amount.

blocks.text: Second combat phase

blocks.html: In addition to the previous phase's attacks, when Nomad teleports you near him and orders you to 'face his wrath', switch to your shield to use Resonance to negate any and all damage from the attack.
blocks.text: In addition to the previous phase's attacks, when Nomad teleports you near him and orders you to 'face his wrath', switch to your shield to use Resonance to negate any and all damage from the attack.
Death

blocks.html: Go directly north, south, east and west of Gielinor. Each time provoking him and quickly getting out of the way, to then use Scythe on the hand, and finally claim the released spirit.
blocks.text: Go directly north, south, east and west of Gielinor. Each time provoking him and quickly getting out of the way, to then use Scythe on the hand, and finally claim the released spirit.
Third combat phase

blocks.html: In addition to the previous phases' attacks, Nomad will create a clone of himself when he reaches half health. Kill them both (you might kill Nomad first, in which case you will move on).
blocks.text: In addition to the previous phases' attacks, Nomad will create a clone of himself when he reaches half health. Kill them both (you might kill Nomad first, in which case you will move on).
Icthlarin

blocks.html: Quickly and without stopping, run around the area anti-clockwise, releasing the souls as you get in the middle of a group of them. Make sure to get over half of the initial total number of spirits.
blocks.text: Quickly and without stopping, run around the area anti-clockwise, releasing the souls as you get in the middle of a group of them. Make sure to get over half of the initial total number of spirits.

blocks.html: The more souls you release, the more powerful the attack reflected onto Gielinor will be.
blocks.text: The more souls you release, the more powerful the attack reflected onto Gielinor will be.

blocks.html: Once all souls have been released, continue circling until Gielinor stops firing the beam, then shield yourself from Gielinor's attack with the ability, in order to reflect the damage onto Gielinor.
blocks.text: Once all souls have been released, continue circling until Gielinor stops firing the beam, then shield yourself from Gielinor's attack with the ability, in order to reflect the damage onto Gielinor.

blocks.html: You will have to repeat this process a few times.
blocks.text: You will have to repeat this process a few times.
Final combat phase

blocks.html: In this phase, Nomad will only be using rapid melee attacks. Kill him by any means. If using Ranged, Magic or Necromancy, then you can run around the room to avoid damage from Nomad, using Surge to gain distance. Watch out for Gielinor's attacks. Protect from Melee or Deflect Melee, especially combined with Devotion, can reduce or negate much of Nomad's damage in this phase, though the speed of his attacks can still be problematic.
